author: SledHead52003
body: Dear Members/Administrators the Avicus Network. I am very sorry for using the hacked client on your server if you give me a chance to prove my self I will not use it. I did indeed use it. The reason was for people being absoloutly rude and jerks to me. I was tired of having to deal with people bulling me. You could probably care less but I get bullied out side of the computer world an playing MC is like my comfort zone. I dont worry about anything or think about anything, but when someone starts to be jerk to me it makes me angry and upset. Again if you do indeed let me back on the server I would very much appreciate it. If you catch me with it again which you most likely wont you can perminatly IP ban me from the server. I hope you accept my appology

title: UnBan

replies.author: hasl
replies.body:
Hello,

I am sorry to hear you're being bullied, but that is no excuse to break the rules here at Avicus is it now? So if you really do care for this server then you can try to get appealed next Spring. As for now I'm afraid you won't be given another chance.
-Denied

Regards,
Aura
